BiblicalUsage: Epilysis is interpretation, explanation — and Peter says no prophecy of the Scripture is of any private interpretation. The prophets did not speak their own meaning into the words; holy men spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.
TheologicalSignificance: Scripture interprets Scripture, and no one man's reading owns it — that is how this verse guards the Bible from private invention.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
